text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whoosh, whoosh)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(I can't afford to lose.
I can't just hand it over...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I must definitely run a race
that surpasses Falcon-san."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—At the training camp grounds. Staring out at the sea,
Furioso steeled her resolve.”

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
However... That speed, that lack of any opening,
and above all... that sheer ambition...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, no matter how much
training I undergo—
choice_data_list: Yeah, they might just get the upper hand on us...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon possesses so many qualities.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her many "fans."
Her "sense of responsibility" to cheer everyone up.
Her "brightness" that never lets her brood over things.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her very existence was a crystallization of positivity.
Truly the quintessential Tracen Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If their abilities are equal, her sheer scale
will undoubtedly carry her through to victory.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I feel it once more.
The URA is strong. And... they are right.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The small rarely ever triumph...
over something so grand and righteous...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Is that also the case at Funabashi Tracen?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Is there really no such thing as our own distinct strength?
Is that why regional Umamusume all transfer away...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was like... a microcosm of society.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A major metropolis over a regional town.
A giant conglomerate over a small company.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The small simply lose and vanish.
Or else, they are merely absorbed...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Does neither we... nor Funabashi...
have anything that can stand up to Falcon-san?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?
choice_data_list: It has to be there. Surely, in Funabashi...
It has to be there. I'm sure it's in Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Doing the same thing won't bring victory.
If so, I have no choice but to find something different—something they cannot do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are definitely things only an Umamusume from Funabashi,
only Furioso, can do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I will find that clue.
By this summer sea, without fail.
